title: Grimoire Mutating Rite Profiles
description: Authoritative contract for write-capable rites: whether they plan, apply, append, or only write through an explicit operation.

profiles.idempotency: Refuses to overwrite an existing manifest, and refuses a skill prefix another grimoire or the framework owns; rerun returns a validation failure without changing the file.
profiles.validation_profile: python rites/sync_library.py --home <home>; python rites/validate_grimoire_structure.py --grimoire <target> after the grimoire has a full scaffold.

profiles.idempotency: Refuses to overwrite an existing page; rerun returns a refusal without changing the file. A grimoire registered for reading on this computer is refused in plan and apply mode.

writes: supported agent skill directories under the user's home directory
profiles.idempotency: Rerunning with the same inputs produces the same rendered skill files; stale cleanup removes any directory in a managed prefix (the framework's prefix or the prefix of any library grimoire) that is not in the current catalog. With --reset-managed, all managed namespace directories are removed before re-registration. Directories outside every managed prefix are never touched.
profiles.validation_profile: python rites/sync_skills.py --dry-run; temp-target pytest coverage for dry-run, repeated apply, overwrite of an unmarked managed dir, stale cleanup, managed-namespace reset, outside-namespace preservation, and prefix collisions.

writes: active-grimoire chapter pages and folders (moves, renames, removals), the wikilinks that target them, and the frontmatter sources entries that cite them
profiles.idempotency: Refuses a move whose destination exists and a remove of a missing path; after a move, rerunning the same move refuses (source no longer present). Link and sources rewrites are exact-target replacements, so a re-run finds nothing left to retarget. Every argument must resolve inside chapters/; anything else is refused. A grimoire registered for reading on this computer is refused in plan and apply mode.
profiles.validation_profile: python rites/validate_links.py --grimoire <path>; python rites/validate_orphans.py --grimoire <path>; python rites/validate_grimoire_structure.py --grimoire <path>; python rites/validate_provenance.py --grimoire <path>

writes: active-grimoire Markdown files with unambiguous wikilink repairs
profiles.idempotency: After apply, rerun reports no repairs for links it already normalized. A grimoire registered for reading on this computer is refused with --apply; a plan run stays allowed.
Install/update behavior is governed by the Summoning Rite contract and mode-specific prompts.
profiles.validation_profile: Summoning Rite contract checks and a source-install smoke test.

writes: agent instruction files (the routing block, through apply_routing_block, which inject_agent_file and summon --reconcile also call)
profiles.idempotency: Install/update behavior is governed by the Summoning Rite contract and mode-specific prompts. The routing block is idempotent: an absent file is created with the canonical block, a block-less file gets one inserted, a single clean marked region is refreshed in place, and a block already matching the template is left unchanged. A file with duplicate or malformed markers, or one that is not UTF-8, is left untouched and reported for the agentfile judgment edit. The library write keeps every unknown field and refuses a library.json that cannot be read.

writes: ~/.cache/grimoire/summon-last.json (the transcript of every install and state command)
profiles.idempotency: --check and the plan forms of --reconcile and --update write only the transcript. With --apply, a second run on a converged install changes nothing: the library, the skill folders and the routing blocks are written through sync_library.update_library, sync_skills and summon_core.apply_routing_block, each of which is idempotent. An agent whose home folder is absent is not configured.
profiles.validation_profile: python rites/summon.py --check --format json (exit 0 means in sync); python -m pytest tests/test_summon_state.py tests/test_summon_state_surface.py

profiles.idempotency: After apply, rerun reports docs/skills.md is up to date.

Every library writer (this rite, summon --reconcile and the installer) writes through update_library under compare-and-swap: it re-reads and rebuilds when library.json changed since it was read, so a concurrent writer's change is incorporated and not overwritten; a persistent conflict fails loudly, and a library.json that cannot be read is left as it is. After apply, rerun reports the library is in sync unless disk state changed.
profiles.validation_profile: python rites/sync_library.py; python rites/sync_skills.py --dry-run after approved library changes.

writes: grimoire working trees (fast-forward-only pulls); during heal, framework-owned managed scaffold, absent seeded files, root sources moved into the citing chapter with their citations, the README update block, and wikilinks repaired by repair_links.py
profiles.idempotency: Pulls are fast-forward-only and heals are idempotent: a second run on a current, clean library pulls nothing and heals nothing new. A grimoire with no shared copy (`local_only`) is healed and never pulled. Grimoires that are dirty, diverged, or unreachable are reported and left untouched. A grimoire registered for reading on this computer is fast-forwarded but never healed or re-validated.
profiles.validation_profile: python rites/summon.py --update; python rites/validate.py --grimoire <path> --summary after apply.

profiles.idempotency: Re-running fast-forwards an existing clone and rewrites the same library entry; never re-clones over a working tree. A folder that is not a git checkout is an error and is left alone; a failed pull keeps the checkout and is a warning. A grimoire with no library entry is registered for reading unless --access edit is given; an existing entry keeps its own access unless --access is given. A checkout that came from another address stops the rite with nothing changed; --switch-url points it at the new address after checking that both hold the same history. A credential in the link stays in the checkout's git configuration and is never written to library.json or to the envelope; a link that differs from the checkout's address only by its credential gives the checkout that credential once a fetch with it succeeds. A checkout that ends registered for reading while it holds unsaved changes or unshared commits gets a warning.

A clean, up-to-date grimoire is a noop; a conflict pauses the rebase with the local commit kept and conflict markers in the pages, so re-running after the markers are removed continues the rebase and completes the save; --abandon ends a paused save and restores the recorded commit. A grimoire registered for reading on this computer is refused in every mode.
profiles.validation_profile: The plan runs validate.py --grimoire <path> and refuses to commit a failing grimoire.

profiles.idempotency: Rendering is a pure function of the skill sources and their invocations, the plugin descriptions in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, and the routing block template; a second apply is a noop.
profiles.validation_profile: python rites/build_plugins.py (exit 0 when the committed render matches the sources); python -m pytest tests/test_build_plugins.py

writes: <grimoire>/publish/content/ (emptied and rewritten; content_dir must be a folder below publish/ that holds no publishing settings)
profiles.idempotency: Staging is a pure function of the grimoire content and publish.json; a second apply produces the same tree.

writes: ~/.claude/settings.json (the autoUpdate key on the Grimoire marketplace entry)
profiles.idempotency: Re-running after the key is set changes nothing; every other setting in the file is preserved.

writes: ~/grimoires/library.json (the access field of the grimoire's entry)
profiles.idempotency: Re-running after the access is set changes nothing; every other field and entry in the library is preserved. Without --set the rite only reports.
profiles.validation_profile: python rites/grimoire_access.py --grimoire <path> --format json (summary.access is the value set)
